test_safety.baseline_method: Disposable source reconstruction reverses only R3 changes, retaining pre-existing uncommitted work. Original read-only status and pre-edit restricted test attempt were also inspected.
test_safety.offline_harness: Host-default MCP singleton configuration redirected to an empty temporary JSON file; tests/rag.test.cjs excluded; per-test deadline 60s.
test_safety.unexpected_initial_rag_process: An initial broad run launched the host-configured Gmail MCP process from an existing RAG test. Only those test-owned processes were terminated. No MCP operation was intentionally issued; external startup activity was not verified. Later runs isolated MCP configuration and excluded this test.
test_safety.live_conversation_database_access: SQLite read-only URI for audit only; all implementation tests use temporary databases.
test_safety.new_database_table: Additive attachment_read_refs initialized only in disposable test databases during implementation.
